verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows that Daily's own video/voice platform or SDKs are published as readable source under an open license. The only open-source mention is Pipecat, a separate orchestration framework that Daily promotes. That is an adjacent product, not this product's source, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Pipecat is a vendor-neutral open source orchestration framework for realtime voice and multimodal AI agents.
